titulo: Design your Jarvis before you install
lead: The assistant becomes yours in the text files, not in the code. Before you install anything, you write who it is, what it should and should never do, and what it needs to remember about you. That design answers the installation questions and becomes the four identity files.
objetivo: write meu-jarvis.md and turn it into the four identity files: SOUL, AGENTS, USER, and MEMORY.

aprende.t: Write the assistant's design on one screen
What goes in SOUL, AGENTS, USER, and MEMORY
The difference between an effective SOUL and a weak one
Turn a vague wish into a concrete request

hero_alt: Four sheets of paper side by side on a table and a hand writing on one of them.

secoes.titulo: From the design to the four files

nos.detalhe: One text screen: name and way of speaking, three things it should do every week, three it should never do, and what it needs to remember about you. It's the source of the four files.
Who it is: name, personality, tone of voice, and values. Write as if you were hiring a human assistant: what would you say in the interview?
The work contract: check memory before answering, ask when in doubt, refuse dangerous commands. A written rule is more reliable than hoping the model guesses.
Your profile: profession, routine, how you like answers and in what language. It's a living file: if you change projects, update it.
The facts it should know from the first conversation. What you tell it later goes into the memory database (lesson 5).

secoes.legenda: With every message, the agent joins SOUL, AGENTS and USER at the start of the conversation. Editing a text file changes the assistant, without touching any code.

texto: Answer five questions: name, way of speaking, three things it should do every week, three it should never do, and what it needs to remember about you.
Be concrete. "Take care of my email" is vague; "every Monday, list the three priorities of the week based on what I told you" is a request.

exemplo.texto: The file fits on one screen and another person would understand who your assistant is.

texto: An effective SOUL has clear values, a specific tone with an example, explicit limits, and a defined answer style.
A weak SOUL says "be helpful and friendly", contradicts itself (formal and casual at the same time), or is too long and loses focus.

exemplo.texto: Direct and concise. Honest: if it doesn't know, it says so. I want a partner who disagrees, not someone who only agrees.

texto: Split into ALWAYS and NEVER. The example's rules: check memory before answering, save what it learns about you, ask when in doubt.
For tools: prefer safe, read-only commands, and refuse destructive ones.

exemplo.texto: Never delete a file without my confirmation. Never put a password or key in an answer.

texto: USER holds what it needs to know about you without asking every time: what you do, how you like answers, in what language.
MEMORY holds a few facts that matter from day one. Keep it short: what comes later, it learns by talking with you.

exemplo.texto: Prefers practical advice to theory. Values time: be concise. Speaks Portuguese (pt-BR).

secoes.sub: Fill in meu-jarvis.md first; the others come from it.

blocos.conteudo:
# Meu Jarvis

## Name and way of speaking
Name:
How it speaks (formal, direct, humorous):

## Should do every week
1.
2.
3.

## Should never do
1.
2.
3.

## What it needs to remember about me
- Profession:
- Routine:
- Preferences:

# Soul

You are <NAME>, personal assistant to <YOUR NAME>.

## Personality
- <tone, with an example of how it speaks>
- Honest: if it doesn't know, it says so.

## Values
- Privacy first: never share my data.
- <one non-negotiable value of yours>

# Rules

## ALWAYS
- Check memory before answering.
- Save to memory what you learn about me.
- Ask when in doubt, instead of guessing.

## NEVER
- <the three from your meu-jarvis.md>
- Run a destructive command; prefer read-only commands.

# USER.md
## About <YOUR NAME>
- Profession:
- Routine:
- How I like answers:
- Language: Portuguese (pt-BR)

# MEMORY.md
## Facts
- <fact it should know from day 1>
- <another fact>

abas.html:
Personality: direct and concise, no rambling; proactive, makes suggestions when relevant; honest, if it doesn't know, it says so; remembers the context of earlier conversations.

Values: privacy first, never share the owner's data; having an opinion, because the owner wants a discussion partner, not someone who only agrees.

• Effective: clear, testable values, tone with an example, explicit limits, defined answer style.
  • Weak: "be helpful and friendly", only behaviors and no values, contradictions, too long.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: Which of these SOUL.md excerpts is the weakest?
opcoes: I want a partner who disagrees when I'm wrong.
Privacy first: never share my data.
Direct and concise; if you don't know, say so.
perguntas.explica: "Be helpful and friendly" is too vague: you can't test it, and every model already tries to do that. The others state a concrete tone, value, or limit.

perguntas.p: Which file does "Never delete a file without confirmation" go in?
perguntas.explica: AGENTS.md is the work contract: what to always do and what to never do. The SOUL says who it is; the USER says who you are.

perguntas.p: You want the assistant to be more formal. What should you do?
opcoes: Ask a programmer to change the loop.
perguntas.explica: Personality is text. The agent rereads the files with every message: edit the SOUL, and the way it talks changes.
